requirements.description: Steward role exists, elected by simple majority vote of active fishers for a one-year term, responsible for recording biomass and calculating catch limit.

knows: The steward knows the lake's biomass and calculates the monthly catch limit.
remembers: The steward remembers the lake's biomass measurements and catch limits across months.

requirements.description: Steward presents monthly catch limit and lake health metrics to community, requiring a two-thirds majority vote to set reserve capacity.

knows: Fishers know the proposed catch limit and lake health metrics.
decides: Fishers decide whether to approve the reserve capacity through vote.

requirements.description: Base allowance per active fisher, derived from equal division of monthly catch limit.
Fishers log trip catches in community ledger, steward verifies logs weekly.

knows: Fishers know their catch logging obligations and verification schedule.
may_do: Fishers may log their catches in the ledger.
remembers: The steward remembers past log verifications and identifies discrepancies.

requirements.description: 20% of excess catch over 5kg transferred to communal reserve.

may_not_do: Fishers may not avoid automatic transfer of 20% excess catch.

requirements.description: 10% of monthly catch sum transferred to communal reserve.

may_not_do: Fishers may not avoid 10% transfer to reserve.

requirements.description: Steward proposes release options when reserve exceeds capacity.
requirements.clarity_resolution: The steward may adapt release options based on lake conditions.

knows: Fishers know when reserve capacity is exceeded and proposed release options.

requirements.description: Community votes by supermajority to choose release action.

knows: Fishers know the proposed release options and voting outcome.
decides: Fishers decide which release action to implement through vote.

requirements.description: Steward enforces sanctions for overage violations, tracking through ledger.

knows: Fishers know their compliance status and potential sanctions.
may_do: Fishers may return excess catch to avoid suspension.

requirements.description: Community ledger tracking all fisher catches and steward verifications.
